tools.name: query_module
tools.title: Query module
tools.description: Read rows from any module (projects, attendance, employees, site visits, maintenance, timesheets, expenses, notifications, audit logs, and more) with filters, date range, sorting and pagination. Row-level security applies, so only data the signed-in user may see is returned.

select.description: Comma-separated column list. Defaults to all columns.

value.description: Value to compare. Omit for is_null / not_null. Array for `in`.

date_from.description: Inclusive start for the module's date column (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Inclusive end for the module's date column (YYYY-MM-DD).

order_by.description: Column to sort by. Defaults to the module's natural order.
